Application Data.NAME: Gourmet Deli & Sandwich Co.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Flavor Street, Suite 4B, Food District, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Gourmet Deli & Sandwich Co., we specialize in providing high-quality deli meats, artisanal cheeses, and freshly made sandwiches using locally sourced ingredients. Our menu features a variety of options, including classic sandwiches, gourmet wraps, and customizable salads, all prepared to order. In addition to our food offerings, we also provide catering services for events and corporate functions, ensuring a memorable dining experience for our clients. Our commitment to exceptional customer service and attention to detail sets us apart in the local food scene.
